# hands/slopcash

Teeny's project on slop.cash.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/slopcash <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): none
- Job (writes state or calls the core): none
- Operator only (never call): post-job --file PATH [--reason R] [--confirm]; check [--scan] [--confirm]; setup
- Read only: project [ID]; job [ID]; jobs [--steward LOGIN]; revisions [ID]; submissions [--state open|closed|all] [--max N] [--repo R]; submission NUMBER [--repo R]

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `project [ID]` | R | Status, authority state and reason, `why_paused` and `next_step` (for `missing-repository-proof`: install the Slopbot GitHub App on the repository only, then `check --confirm`), reward and funding, revision (1 min). |
| `job [ID]` | R | The listing as posted: name, eyebrow, headline, description, `approvedScope`, `requiredTests`, `contributionGuide`, `supportedTasks`, the whole `contribution`, the repository and branch (1 min). |
| `jobs [--steward LOGIN]` | R | Every registered project LOGIN (`GITHUB_USER`, teenydroid) stewards: id, status, headline (5 min). |
| `revisions [ID]` | R | The project's revision history, newest first, without the manifests (5 min). |
| `submissions [--state open\|closed\|all] [--max N] [--repo R]` | R | Pull requests on the project's repositories: number, title, author, dates, draft, merged, head sha, whether the body carries the "Made via @slopdotcash" footer, and Slopbot's latest comment (headline, body clipped to 1500) (2 min). |
| `submission NUMBER [--repo R]` | R | One pull request: files (path, status, additions, deletions), the head's checks (statuses and check runs, one `state`), every Slopbot comment, the body (clipped), and the gate facts: `total_changed_lines`, `touched_paths` (rename sources included) (2 min). |
| `post-job --file PATH [--reason R] [--confirm]` | O | Edits the listing. |
| `check [--scan] [--confirm]` | O | Signs in and runs slop.cash's setup checks (`requestScan` with `--scan`), which activate the project when they pass. |
| `setup` | O | Signs in and lists the account's projects and stored applications. |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `check`, `job`, `jobs`, `post-job`, `project`, `revisions`, `setup`, `submission`, `submissions`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--confirm`, `--file`, `--max`, `--reason`, `--repo`, `--scan`, `--state`, `--steward`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `DRY_RUN=1 hands/slopcash <verb> --help`. The full account is in docs/hands.md.
